plans.deleteHint: The archives it made stay in their storages.

kindHint.postgres: A PostgreSQL database, dumped with pg_dump on this server.
kindHint.mysql: A MySQL or MariaDB database, dumped with mysqldump on this server.

kindHint.files: Directories and files on this server, packed into one archive.

url.label: Paste connection URL
url.hint: Fills in the fields below. The URL itself is not saved.

url.invalid: This is not a postgres:// or mysql:// URL

fields.passwordKeep: Stored. Leave blank to keep it

keep.weekly: Also keep one backup per week for
keep.monthly: Also keep one backup per month for

plans.enabledHint: When off, the plan keeps its settings but does not run on its schedule.

storages.title: Storages
storages.subtitle: Where backups are kept: a directory on this server, an S3-compatible bucket or a Google Cloud Storage bucket.

kindHint.local: A directory on the server Gogobackup runs on. It must already exist and be writable by the service.
kindHint.s3: Amazon S3, or any S3-compatible service: MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi.
kindHint.gcs: A Google Cloud Storage bucket, reached with a service-account key.

storages.secretKeepPlaceholder: Stored. Leave blank to keep it
storages.deleteHint: Files already in it stay. Gogobackup forgets its record of the archives there, and retention no longer deletes them.

local.pathHint: An absolute path on the server, such as /var/backups/gogobackup.

s3.endpointHint: Leave blank for Amazon S3. For other services, their URL, such as https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com.
s3.pathStyleHint: Turn on for MinIO and other servers that do not support bucket subdomains.

gcs.credentialsHint: Paste the key file, or load it. The account needs to create, read and delete objects in the bucket.

storages.prefixHint: Optional. Backups go under this folder, such as gogobackup/.
storages.testOk: Connection works: a test file was written, read back and deleted.
storages.inUse: Backup plans upload to this storage: {{plans}}. Remove it from those plans first.

restores.sqlitePathHint: An absolute path in an existing directory. A file already there is kept as <file>.before-restore-<time>.

own.title: This replaces the plan's own data
own.postgres: Every table in the archive is dropped and restored from it in this database. Changes made since the backup are lost.
own.mysql: The archive runs against this database: its tables are dropped and created again. Changes made since the backup are lost.
own.sqlite: The file is replaced. The current one is kept next to it as a .before-restore copy. Stop the application that uses it first.
own.files: Files are written back to the paths the plan backs up and overwrite what is there.
